result.summary.online: {count} warning signs plus an online match
result.summary.online.one: 1 warning sign plus an online match
result.summary.online.many: {count} warning signs plus an online match
result.explanation.sample: This combines a demand for money with a request for account details, a pattern consistent with phishing or financial fraud that requires independent verification.
result.explanation.plainLanguage: A direct demand for money and account details with no context, which is concerning for phishing or extortion.
result.whyDetails: These warning signs contributed to the result:
result.advice: Do not tap the link or send the code. Open the wallet app yourself or call its official number, then block and report the sender.
result.advice.low: No strong warning signs were found, but double-check unexpected requests through official channels.
result.advice.suspicious: Do not tap the link or send the code. Open the wallet app yourself or call its official number, then block and report the sender.
result.advice.high: Don't engage. Block and report the sender, and contact the organization through its official app or number.
result.advice.unknown: Share more of the message or the full link, or treat it as unsafe. Don't click, pay, or share codes until you confirm with the sender.
report.title: Surfare — Check Report
result.insufficient: There is not enough information to judge this safely. Treat it as unsafe until you can verify it.
signal.threat_loss: Threat of losing access or money.
signal.money_demand: Demand for money or a transfer.
signal.impersonation: Claims to represent a known organization.
signal.secrecy: Pressure to keep the request secret.
signal.job_scam: A work offer promises easy or task-based money.
signal.romance_or_emergency: An emergency or personal crisis may be used to pressure you.
signal.generic_greeting: A generic greeting may indicate a mass message.
signal.link_in_message: A link is included in the message.
signal.link_mismatch: Link that does not match the brand.
signal.ip_host: The link uses a numeric network address.
signal.url_shortener: The link hides its destination behind a shortener.
signal.brand_in_subdomain_not_domain: A brand name appears in a subdomain, not the actual site.
signal.lookalike_brand: The website name resembles a known brand.
signal.no_https: The link does not use a secure HTTPS connection.
signal.risky_tld: The website uses a less common domain ending.
signal.at_symbol: The link contains an unusual @ sign.
signal.punycode_or_homoglyph: The website address may use look-alike characters.
signal.long_or_encoded_url: The link is unusually long or encoded.
signal.redirect_param: The link contains a redirect parameter.
signal.non_standard_port: The website uses an unusual connection port.
signal.excessive_subdomains: The website address has an unusually large number of subdomains.
signal.data_or_javascript_scheme: The link uses a non-web or executable address scheme.
signal.online_match: Online lookup: the link appears on a sample list of known phishing sites.
signal.invalid_url: The link could not be read as a valid web address.

privacy.title: Your privacy matters
privacy.body: Checks run on your device by default, and your content is not saved. When an online URL lookup runs, only the web address is sent. Never share passwords or private codes.
privacy.question: What could be sent when online checks are added?
privacy.links: Link checks: only the web address.
privacy.text: Text checks: the message stays on your device; only detected web addresses may be sent if online checks are enabled.
privacy.image: Image or QR checks: the picture stays on your device; only a decoded web address may be sent if online checks are enabled.

how.title: From suspicious to explained in five steps
how.step.1.title: Submit
how.step.1.body: Share a message, link, image, or QR code.
how.step.2.title: Identify
how.step.2.body: Surfare detects the file type and picks the right method.
how.step.3.title: Check on device
how.step.3.body: Stored detection rules look for warning signs, no internet needed.
how.step.4.title: Verify online
how.step.4.body: When connected, a threat-checking service adds more evidence.
how.step.5.title: Explain
how.step.5.body: A risk level, the reasons, and safe next steps in plain language.

ask.title: Ask Surfy
ask.imageAlt: Surfy winking and giving a thumbs-up
ask.fallback: I can help with these questions:
ask.link.low: This check found no strong warning signs, but no link check can guarantee a site is safe. Open it only if you trust the sender.
ask.link.caution: I wouldn't open it yet. Verify the address through the service's official app or website first.
ask.link: Is this link safe to open?
ask.uncertain: What if you are not sure?
ask.greeting: I found {count} warning signs. Ask me anything!
ask.offline.answer: Text, link, image, and QR checks can run on your device without internet. An online URL lookup needs a connection.
ask.photo.answer: No. Photos are processed on your device and aren't saved or uploaded by this app.
